skill.name: hyperframes-keyframes
skill.description: Create seek-safe 2D and 3D keyframe animation for HyperFrames compositions using GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, WAAPI, SVG, and WebGL patterns.
skill.summary: Guides HyperFrames authors to build deterministic keyframes and verify motion with focused diagnostics.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown inline-code false positives around animation APIs, CLI flags, and examples. The only confirmed issue is limited external command usage: the skill tells users to run HyperFrames diagnostics with npx, which is legitimate for this workflow but should require normal command approval.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends npx HyperFrames diagnostic commands.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that commands should run only in trusted HyperFrames projects and prefer an installed, reviewed HyperFrames CLI when available.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples trigger many command-execution false positives.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command examples in a clearly labeled diagnostics section and avoid unnecessary inline shell-like syntax outside that section.

content.value_statement: HyperFrames animations can fail when motion is not seek-safe or visually proven. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to author deterministic keyframes and verify important frames.
actual_capabilities: Selects suitable keyframe mechanisms for GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, WAAPI, SVG, DOM 3D, and WebGL motion.
Defines seek-safe runtime rules such as paused timelines, finite loops, deterministic delays, and registered animation instances.
Guides verification with HyperFrames lint, validate, keyframes, shot, ghost, and snapshot diagnostics.
Explains how to preserve subject identity, final states, readable text, and visible proof poses.
Provides troubleshooting guidance for endpoint-only motion, fake 3D, wrong finals, and unreadable text.
limitations: It does not plan broad scene concepts, brand direction, media sourcing, captions, or full video strategy.
It assumes the project already uses HyperFrames and has compatible animation tooling available.
It gives implementation guidance, but the user must still review generated motion and rendered frames.
Some recommended diagnostics run local CLI commands and may need user approval.

use_cases.title: Create seek-safe product motion
use_cases.description: Build deterministic keyframes for product cards, UI states, and hero transitions that can be scrubbed and rendered reliably.

use_cases.title: Verify generated animation frames
use_cases.description: Check proof poses, final lockups, text readability, and 3D depth with focused HyperFrames diagnostics.

use_cases.title: Choose the right animation mechanism
use_cases.description: Map a motion need to FLIP, path travel, stroke draw, shape morphing, clip masks, staggered text, or WebGL keyframes.
use_cases.target_user: Claude Code users editing HyperFrames compositions

prompt_templates.title: Add basic keyframe motion
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple deterministic animation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HyperFrames keyframes skill to animate this subject from its start pose to its final pose. Keep the runtime seek-safe and verify the final frame.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing animation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for fixing weak or endpoint-only motion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this HyperFrames composition for endpoint-only motion. Add visible middle poses, preserve subject identity, and describe the verification shots I should run.

prompt_templates.title: Select a motion mechanism
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for choosing between animation techniques.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the smallest keyframe mechanism for this motion goal. Compare FLIP, path travel, masks, SVG draw, and DOM 3D only where relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose rendered motion proof
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HyperFrames keyframes diagnostics guidance to explain why this shot or snapshot fails. Propose the smallest source change and the next focused diagnostic.

output_examples.input: Animate a dashboard card expanding into a detail panel.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a shared-element or FLIP-style transition, one continuous transform path, a final hold, and snapshots at start, midpoint, and final frames.

output_examples.input: Make a logo outline draw on while the text remains readable.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests stroke draw for the outline, stable text layout, a partial mid-frame proof, and a final snapshot showing complete text fit.

output_examples.input: Fix a 3D scene that looks flat in the render.
output_examples.output: The skill points to z travel, camera or target keyframes, occlusion, angled proof shots, and ghost diagnostics for canvas or WebGL motion.

best_practices: Name the animated subject, proof poses, and final state before changing timing or easing.
Use deterministic runtimes with finite durations, paused timelines, registered instances, and no render-critical timers.
Verify pixels with focused shots and snapshots instead of trusting logs or helper overlays alone.
anti_patterns: Do not use Date.now, performance.now, unseeded random values, infinite loops, or hover triggers for render-critical motion.
Do not replace a subject with a crossfade when the viewer should see one continuous object move.
Do not rely on endpoint-only animation when the prompt requires visible travel, depth, shape change, or state progression.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create deterministic HyperFrames keyframes for 2D, 3D, SVG, text, path, mask, and WebGL animation.

faq.question: Can it design a full video concept?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on keyframe implementation and verification, not broad scene strategy or creative direction.

faq.question: Which runtimes does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, SVG techniques, DOM 3D, Three.js, and WebGL patterns.

faq.question: Why does seek-safe animation matter?
faq.answer: Seek-safe animation renders correctly at any requested time, which is required for reliable shots, snapshots, and video output.

faq.question: Does the skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends HyperFrames diagnostics, but command execution still depends on the user and tool permission settings.

faq.question: How should I verify the result?
faq.answer: Run focused diagnostics for the animated subject and compare snapshots for the first frame, proof poses, final-minus-hold, and final frame.
